# LLM Free

> LLM Free is a professional AI API gateway for developers and teams. It provides an OpenAI-compatible endpoint for accessing Claude, GPT, Gemini, and other supported models through one API.

## Official URLs

- Website: https://llmfree.work/home
- API endpoint: https://api.llmfree.work
- Sitemap: https://llmfree.work/sitemap.xml
- Telegram community: https://t.me/+nqFUXD_y66liYTll

## Core capabilities

- OpenAI-compatible API protocol
- Unified access to multiple leading AI model providers
- API key management
- Request, token usage, and cost visibility
- Routing and availability management

## Intended audience

LLM Free serves developers, AI application builders, automation teams, and organizations that need a stable unified interface for multiple large language models.
